# 24th Street Cigar Lounge

> Family-run cigar lounge and full bar in Phoenix, Arizona, co-owned by George Janko. Verified facts, checked 2026-11-11 from the business's own website and listings.

## Key facts
- Name: 24th Street Cigar Lounge
- Address: 3407 N 24th St, Phoenix, AZ 85016 (corner of 24th Street and Osborn)
- Phone: (602) 235-0096
- Hours: Sunday 12 PM - 8 PM; Monday-Thursday 3 PM - 10 PM; Friday-Saturday 3 PM - 12 AM (54 hours open per week)
- Offerings: 300 cigar options (light bodied to full, from around the globe); 50 premium spirits and craft cocktails; full bar; back patio with outdoor seating; TVs; lot parking
- Story: Began as a liquor market, transformed into a lounge; family-run; co-owned by George Janko
- Events: Hosts brand cigar nights and giveaways (examples from its Facebook page: Gurkha Cigars event, October 8; Oliva Thanksgiving Giveaway, November 12, 5-9 PM); private booking inquiries by phone
- Reviews: 4.1 stars from 21 reviews on Yelp (not a Google rating; no Google rating was verified)
- Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/274634415740737 ; Instagram https://www.instagram.com/24thstreetcigarlounge ; Yelp https://www.yelp.com/biz/ukFbQtQiIh6yJv3GcyOx6A

## Notes
- No email address, menu prices, or membership/locker program are published by this business; none are claimed here.
- Reservations, group nights and private event inquiries: call (602) 235-0096. Walk-ins are welcome during open hours.
